message.content:
This document is a technical README for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash). Key technical points:

**Architecture & Models**
- Runs 320B-parameter GLM-5.3-Flash (18B active/token) via a 3:1 linear-attention (KDA) / sparse-attention (DSA/MLA) hybrid with hyper-connections (mHC) and MTP drafting.
- Memory tiers: VR
